_schema_doc: Honey-equivalent values for reward shaping during RL. Each pickup/token type maps to how much a real player would trade for it. Used by the Phase 3a RL reward function: reward = Δhoney + sum(collected_items × values). Values are ROUGH — should be tuned per hive stage. Update when the bot progresses (Star Jelly is worth more at 15 bees than at 50 bees).
_stage_hint: Values calibrated for early-to-mid game (~10-25 bees). At endgame, most values scale up 10-100x because your hive extracts more from each material.

pollen_puff.notes: Small pollen from flowers. Half honey because still needs conversion at hive.

ticket.notes: Ticket ≈ what you'd spend to buy the smallest useful ticket item. Ticket Tent purchases scale broadly this range.

royal_jelly.notes: RJ Shop price scales 250k→1M each; usable value is ~5k early (feeds bees) to ~250k late-game.

star_jelly.notes: Rare. Contributes to Star Treats (25 SJ = 1 Star Treat). Bumped high to prioritize.

gumdrop.notes: Gumdrop Shop trades 30 gumdrops for tickets; also feed bond XP; also planter modifier.

enzymes.notes: Both crafting and consumable buff (10 min IC+Convert).

moon_charm.notes: Night-only. Feeds bond, crafts Moon Amulet.

stinger.notes: Rare crafting mat from Vicious Bee. Not super frequent.

magic_bean.notes: Trades for special items during Beesmas; low frequency.

cloud_vial_pickup.notes: Cap 10 held — don't over-value if already at cap.

ability_tokens._notes: Ability tokens are TIME-VALUED — worth their expected honey delta during their stack duration. Values assume mid-farming state. Reward shaping should also decay these to 0 if not immediately usable (e.g. Melody with no crit build).

haste.notes: +10% MS per stack, ~5k honey/hour boost while active.

focus.notes: +3% crit chance per stack — mostly matters for combat/bosses.

rage.notes: +1 flat bee attack per stack. Highest boss-fight value.

bomb.notes: Instant nearby-flower harvest. Small direct honey gain.

boost_red.notes: ×1.2 red pollen 15s. Situational to current field color.

token_link.notes: Converts nearby tokens to honey — high value if many tokens on screen.

honey_gift.notes: Instant honey. Literally a honey grant.

sunflower_seed.notes: 25 base / 50 favored bond XP. Value = ~how much bond matters at your hive stage.

neonberry.notes: 500 bond + radioactive; also Super Smoothie ingredient.

bitterberry.notes: Mutation chance is the real value; hard to price.

basic_egg.notes: Basic Egg shop starts at 1k honey; value = replacement cost.

gold_egg.notes: Ticket Tent price = 50 tickets; if 1 ticket = 50k, gold ≈ 2.5M. But actual honey equivalent depends on egg contents.
